content_feed.headline: Voltamp Transformers Commences Commercial Production at New Unit-III Facility
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Commencement of commercial production at new plant.
content_feed.telegram_post: 🏭 #COMMERCIAL_PRODUCTION | Voltamp Transformers Limited (NSE: VOLTAMP) Voltamp Transformers Commences Commercial Production at New Unit-III Facility ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - New Facility: Unit-III, Jarod, Vadodara, Gujarat - Commencement Date: 07 Oct 2026 - Product: Power Transformers - Regulation: Regulation 30, SEBI LODR 📌 What happened: ↳ Voltamp Transformers began commercial production at its new state‑of‑the‑art plant for power transformers, effective 07 Oct 2026. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
